title: Start from the pages that sell
text: Before any design work we read your analytics and talk to two of your customers, so the new site keeps what already brings in work.

title: Write before we design
text: Every page gets its words first: a heading, a short answer and the proof behind it. Design follows the copy, never the other way round.

title: Ship small, measure, repeat
text: The first version goes live in four weeks. After launch we look at what visitors read and where they stop, and adjust one page at a time.
